sloka: ततः समीक्ष्य शयने सन्नम् शोकेन पार्थिवम् ।कौसल्या पुत्र शोक आर्ता तम् उवाच मही पतिम् ॥२-४३-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ samīkṣya śayane sannam śokena pārthivam ।kausalyā putra śoka ārtā tam uvāca mahī patim ॥2-43-1॥

translations.english: Struck by the grief of her son's departure, Kausalya looked at the king who lay on the couch completely exhausted and said to him.
